pages.title: Liquid Spacetime
pages.text: Spacetime itself, flowing like a liquid. Distances inside it are fluid, and it ripples with gravitational waves when disturbed. It is cold and has no colour, only the distortion of what is behind it. Poured, it bends the light of the room around the stream.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Some theories describe spacetime as an emergent fluid. Feeding a Cosmic String Segment and raw star matter into the Eye of the Event Horizon, the simulation melted spacetime into a liquid.
